K3 Series Models

All K3 series models support a 1,048,576-token context window. Note: The Kimi API automatically enables context caching billing for repeated request prefixes, with a default TTL (time-to-live) of 5m. For TTL settings and cost optimization tips, see Best Practices for Context Caching. Batch API Inference: kimi-k3.1-pro and kimi-k3 support batch inference for large-scale tasks that do not require real-time responses, billed at 60% of the standard price.

K2 Series Models

All K2 series models support a 262,144-token context window.
Dear Kimi Users, starting October 31, 2026, K2 series models will no longer be available to newly registered users; existing users are not affected. We plan to retire all K2 series models by the end of December 2026, please prepare your migration in advance.
1 MTok = 1,000,000 tokens. All prices above are per MTok consumed.
